requirement.normalizedRequirement: For transverse framing, the thickness of the shell plating shall be determined by t = 667*s*sqrt(f_1*p_pl/sigma_y) + t_c [mm] (4.5). For longitudinal framing, the thickness shall be determined by t = 667*s*sqrt(p/(f_2*sigma_y)) + t_c [mm] (4.6).
